Live burden: The skeptic must show that these intermediate roles either secretly introduce backward-looking justification or contribute nothing unavailable through clearer forward-looking concepts and practices. Locked score: The very-strong band reflects exceptional responsiveness, logical clarity, precise targeting, strong charity, and major leverage against the opposing institutional account, with only a bounded gap concerning sophisticated rule-consequentialist constructions of desert.
